reason: I already take magnesium at night at home, so a sachet to carry around solves a problem I don't really have. A bottle on my nightstand is cheaper and I don't have to think about it.
objection: I'm paying about $30 a month for the packaging, not for anything better in the capsule. I take it at home anyway, so I don't need it to go.
would_change_my_mind: If I could try a small box of 7 sachets for a few dollars to see if I actually use them on trips, or if my next blood test shows I'm low and I'm traveling a lot that month.
